changelog.body:
## Changelog - v2.5.6

### What's New
* **Expanded Liquid Glass Support:**
  * Added Liquid Glass visual options for the Lock Screen Clock.
  * Added Liquid Glass visual options for Moto Widgets.
* **Localization:**
  * Added Russian translation.
  * Added Simplified Chinese (zh-CN) translation.

### Improvements
* **In-App UI Cleanup:** Reorganized module preferences and streamlined interface layouts for improved navigation.

changelog.name: [STABLE]v2.5.5 — Liquid Glass & Stability
changelog.body:
This release brings Liquid Glass styling to key areas across the launcher and SystemUI, adds in-app update checks, and improves reliability across settings, hooks, and device-specific layouts.

✨ Liquid Glass
Notification Center: Added glass styling for notification and media surfaces, including expanded media artwork.
Control Center: Added refined glass surfaces and blur handling for Quick Settings.
Lock Screen: Added optional glass styling for lock-screen shortcuts and playback cards, with compact media controls and improved notification layout behavior.
Desktop: Added glass effects for launcher surfaces, including folders and the main dock.
🔔 Update Checks
Added optional in-app checks for new stable GitHub releases, with a direct link to the release page.
Added version-aware release comparison and safeguards against repeated or unnecessary checks.
🛠️ Stability and Improvements
Improved hook resilience and settings synchronization across the launcher and SystemUI.
Refined control-center layouts, lock-screen media handling, notification behavior, and launcher grid options.
Improved root command handling and scope detection.
📦 Installation & Updating
Install the updated APK over your existing version.
Ensure the module retains the required LSPosed and root permissions.
Reboot or restart SystemUI/Launcher as prompted for the updated hooks to take effect.
Some SystemUI and launcher effects depend on the device ROM and should be verified on-device. Options remain configurable in the app; disable an affected option and restart the corresponding process if needed.

# Motorola Tweak Mod (MockingBat)

An all-in-one customization Xposed / LSPosed module designed for Motorola devices (Hello UI), inspired by LuckyTool.

## ✨ Key Features

### 🎨 UI & Visual Effects
* **Liquid Glass & Frosted Glass UI:** Apply sleek Liquid Glass and Frosted Glass blur effects across the entire system UI.
* **Control Center Tweaks:** Customize Quick Settings / Control Center layout, tiles, and visual elements.
* **Notification Bar & Center:** Modify status bar icons, notification panel behavior, and appearance.
* **Lock Screen Customizations:** Tweak lock screen layout, shortcuts, and visual styles.

### 🏠 Home Screen (Launcher)
* **Grid Adjustments:** Freely customize home screen and app drawer grid sizes, icon layouts, and spacing.

### 🛠️ System & Security Tweaks
* **CorePatch Integration:** Bypass signature verification to allow app downgrades and installing modified APKs.
* **Disable FLAG_SECURE:** Allow screenshots and screen recording in secure apps that normally block them.
* **Disable Camera Shutter Sound:** Force disable the mandatory camera shutter sound on region-locked devices.
* **Auto Update Checker:** Built-in update detection to keep the module up to date.
* *...and many more tweaks!*

## 🔗 Links
* **Source Code & Releases:** https://github.com/Devola-Sun/Motorola-Tweak-Mod
* **XDA Thread:** https://xdaforums.com/t/wip-dev-mockingbat-hello-ui-tweaker-for-motorola-android-15-lsposed-pure-temproot-no-system-mods-needed.4805680/
* **Support & Issues:** https://github.com/Devola-Sun/Motorola-Tweak-Mod/issues

# 摩托罗拉 Tweak Mod (MockingBat)

一款专为摩托罗拉设备（Hello UI）设计的一体化定制 Xpose / LSPod 模块，灵感来自 LuckyTool。

## ✨ 主要特点

### 🎨 用户界面和视觉效果
* **液体玻璃和磨砂玻璃用户界面：** 在整个系统用户界面上应用时尚的液体玻璃和磨砂玻璃模糊效果。
* **控制中心调整：** 自定义快速设置/控制中心布局、图块和视觉元素。
* **通知栏和中心：** 修改状态栏图标、通知面板行为和外观。
* **锁定屏幕自定义：** 调整锁定屏幕布局、快捷方式和视觉样式。

### 🏠 主屏幕（启动器）
* **网格调整：** 自由自定义主屏幕和应用程序抽屉网格大小、图标布局和间距。

### 🛠️ 系统和安全调整
* **CorePatch 集成：** 绕过签名验证以允许应用程序降级和安装修改后的 APK。
* **禁用 FLAG_SECURE：** 允许在通常会阻止它们的安全应用程序中进行屏幕截图和屏幕录制。
* **禁用相机快门声音：** 强制禁用区域锁定设备上的强制相机快门声音。
* **自动更新检查器：** 内置更新检测，使模块保持最新状态。
* *...以及更多调整！*
